_about: Nothing and CMF earbuds and headphones by the product id they report (read 0xC01C), from Nothing X 3.4.15 (com.nothing.smartcenter, decompiled outside the repo on 2026-10-18; none of its code or files are here): the product classes (IOTProductDevice*, their protocol class for crc and activate) and the per-model feature table the app bundles (ear_white_list.json), one entry in configs per firmware range. Names the app gives only as project numbers come from nada and nadamas (MIT), which read them from real devices; B183 is unknown. B190 comes from nadamas alone (its source field). anc decodes ancLevel as bits 0 high, 1 mid, 2 low, 3 adaptive, 4 transparency, 5 off (inferred: the app reads it in its Dart code; docs/nothing/PROTOCOL.md section 6). codecs decodes highQualityAudio (2 LHDC, 4 LDAC). eq_presets is false where the table sets eq 0 (Dirac Opteo models). gestures: device 2 left, 3 right, 6 the whole product; operations the actions the app offers, fixed the ones it shows but does not let the user pick. tried names the open-source project (nada or nadamas, both MIT) that was used with a real one, sending the same messages PairFree sends. reports lists device reports under data/nothing/reports.

devices.name: Nothing Ear (3a)
devices.source: nadamas (MIT), which read product B190 (90 b1) from a real Ear (3a); Nothing X 3.4.15 does not list it, so its features are nadamas' and its gestures unknown
